findings.title: Unreserved duplicate-key JSON is rejected when Unicode escapes trigger inspection
findings.description: The storage_pairs hook invokes unique before establishing reserved storage identity. Ordinary duplicate-key JSON remains raw when literal, but the same nonreserved object with a Unicode-escaped string raises evidence-duplicate-key. This is a narrow fail-closed availability limitation; it does not alter accepted bytes, bypass PASS provenance, or affect selected checks.
findings.suggested_change: In a future compatibility correction, validate duplicate keys for reserved storage objects while preserving unreserved ordinary raw bytes, with literal/escaped parity coverage.
